1.consolidated_definition: En las peleas de gallos, poner los gallos en soleadores pequeños a tomar el sol durante las primeras horas del día.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To acclimate roosters in cockfighting to the sun by placing them in small soleadores (sun shelters) during the early hours of the day.
